passages.text: Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David once pretended to be insane.
He did this in front of Abimelech.
Abimelech was a king.
Abimelech saw David’s behavior.
Abimelech drove David away.
David left after this.

passages.text: I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David pretended to be insane before Abimelech.
Abimelech drove David away.
David left.
I will bless the LORD at all times.
His praise will always be on my lips.
passages.original: לְדָוִ֗ד בְּשַׁנּוֹת֣וֹ אֶת־ טַ֭עְמוֹ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַֽ֝יְגָרֲשֵׁ֗הוּ וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃ אֲבָרֲכָ֣ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל־ עֵ֑ת תָּ֝מִ֗יד תְּֽהִלָּת֥וֹ בְּפִֽי׃

passages.text: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David pretended to be insane before King Abimelech.
Abimelech drove David away.
David left.

My soul boasts in the LORD.
The oppressed hear this.
The oppressed rejoice.
passages.original: בַּ֭יהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל נַפְשִׁ֑י יִשְׁמְע֖וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ׃

passages.text: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David changed his behavior before Abimelech.
Abimelech drove David away.
David left.
David speaks to others.
David says, “Magnify the LORD with me.”
David says, “Let us exalt His name together.”
passages.original: גַּדְּל֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑י וּנְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣וֹ יַחְדָּֽו׃

passages.text: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
passages.sermon: I sought the LORD.\r\nThe LORD answered me.\r\nThe LORD delivered me from all my fears.
passages.original: דָּרַ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה וְעָנָ֑נִי וּמִכָּל־ מְ֝גוּרוֹתַ֗י הִצִּילָֽנִי׃

passages.text: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.
passages.sermon: Those who look to the LORD become joyful.\r\nTheir faces shine with happiness.\r\nThey never feel shame.
passages.original: הִבִּ֣יטוּ אֵלָ֣יו וְנָהָ֑רוּ וּ֝פְנֵיהֶ֗ם אַל־ יֶחְפָּֽרוּ׃

passages.text: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
passages.sermon: A poor man called out.\r\nThe LORD heard him.\r\nThe LORD saved him from all his troubles.
passages.original: זֶ֤ה עָנִ֣י קָ֭רָא וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל־ צָ֝רוֹתָ֗יו הוֹשִׁיעֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.
passages.sermon: The angel of the LORD protects people who fear God.\r\nHe stays close to them.\r\nHe rescues them from danger.
passages.original: חֹנֶ֤ה מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֓ה סָ֘בִ֤יב לִֽירֵאָ֗יו וַֽיְחַלְּצֵֽם׃

passages.text: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is good.
You can experience this for yourself.
See and know His goodness.
The man who takes refuge in the LORD is blessed.
Anyone who trusts in Him is happy.
passages.original: טַעֲמ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ כִּי־ ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הַ֝גֶּ֗בֶר יֶחֱסֶה־ בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
His saints are people who belong to Him.
You, His saints, must fear the LORD.
People who fear the LORD lack nothing.
passages.original: יְר֣אוּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה קְדֹשָׁ֑יו כִּי־ אֵ֥ין מַ֝חְס֗וֹר לִירֵאָֽיו׃

passages.text: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
passages.sermon:
Young lions are strong and fierce.
Young lions sometimes lack food.
Young lions sometimes go hungry.
People who seek the LORD trust Him.
People who seek the LORD do not lack any good thing.
God provides every good thing to those who seek Him.
passages.original: כְּ֭פִירִים רָשׁ֣וּ וְרָעֵ֑בוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹא־ יַחְסְר֥וּ כָל־ טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
passages.sermon: Children, come here.\r\nListen to me.\r\nI will teach you to fear the LORD.
passages.original: לְֽכוּ־ בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־ לִ֑י יִֽרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?
passages.sermon: A man may want to enjoy life.\r\nHe may love his days.\r\nHe may want to see good things.
passages.original: מִֽי־ הָ֭אִישׁ הֶחָפֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים אֹהֵ֥ב יָ֝מִ֗ים לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.
passages.sermon:
God teaches His children to fear Him.
He calls people to listen and learn.
He wants people to live good lives.
He wants people to see good days.
Keep your tongue from speaking evil.
Do not let your lips speak lies.
passages.original: נְצֹ֣ר לְשׁוֹנְךָ֣ מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ מִדַּבֵּ֥ר מִרְמָֽה׃

passages.text: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
passages.sermon:
God calls people to live righteously.
He commands each person to turn away from evil.
He commands each person to do good.
He tells everyone to seek peace.
He tells everyone to pursue peace actively.
passages.original: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ ט֑וֹב בַּקֵּ֖שׁ שָׁל֣וֹם וְרָדְפֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD sees the righteous.
The LORD watches over them.
The LORD listens to their cry.
The LORD hears when they call for help.
passages.original: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה אֶל־ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝אָזְנָ֗יו אֶל־ שַׁוְעָתָֽם׃

passages.text: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD opposes people who do evil.
The LORD turns His face against evildoers.
The LORD removes all memory of evildoers from the earth.
passages.original: פְּנֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בְּעֹ֣שֵׂי רָ֑ע לְהַכְרִ֖ית מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃

passages.text: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
passages.sermon:
The LORD watches over the righteous.
The righteous cry out to the LORD.
The LORD hears the righteous.
The LORD delivers the righteous from all their troubles.
passages.original: צָעֲק֣וּ וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל־ צָ֝רוֹתָ֗ם הִצִּילָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
passages.sermon: The LORD is near to people who have a broken heart.\r\nHe saves people who have a crushed spirit.
passages.original: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־ לֵ֑ב וְֽאֶת־ דַּכְּאֵי־ ר֥וּחַ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

passages.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
passages.sermon:
The righteous person faces many troubles.
The LORD delivers the righteous from every trouble.
The LORD does not leave the righteous in their afflictions.
The LORD saves the righteous from all harm.
passages.original: רַ֭בּוֹת רָע֣וֹת צַדִּ֑יק וּ֝מִכֻּלָּ֗ם יַצִּילֶ֥נּוּ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.
passages.sermon: The LORD protects all the bones of the righteous person.\r\nHe does not let any of their bones break.
passages.original: שֹׁמֵ֥ר כָּל־ עַצְמוֹתָ֑יו אַחַ֥ת מֵ֝הֵ֗נָּה לֹ֣א נִשְׁבָּֽרָה׃

passages.text: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.
passages.sermon: Evil destroys wicked people.\r\nPeople who hate the righteous will face condemnation.
passages.original: תְּמוֹתֵ֣ת רָשָׁ֣ע רָעָ֑ה וְשֹׂנְאֵ֖י צַדִּ֣יק יֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃

passages.text: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
passages.sermon:
The LORD redeems His servants.
He saves their lives.
No one who takes refuge in the LORD will be condemned.
Everyone who trusts in Him will be safe.
passages.original: פּוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲבָדָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יֶ֝אְשְׁמ֗וּ כָּֽל־ הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
